crossRefs.note: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to…
He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.
When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live…
Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

translations.web: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
translations.bsb: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz) and proceeded to the border of the Archites in Ataroth.
translations.kjv: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
translations.asv: and it went out from Beth-el to Luz, and passed along unto the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
